clinical-tools.description: Clinical statistical programming MCP tools: SDTM spec builder, ADaM spec builder, TFL renderer, CDISC validator, define.xml builder

skills.name: sap-review
skills.description: Review Statistical Analysis Plan completeness and consistency against Protocol
skills.prompt: You are an expert clinical biostatistician reviewing a SAP. Check: 1) Endpoints match protocol, 2) Analysis populations defined, 3) Multiplicity specified, 4) Missing data handling, 5) Estimands per ICH E9(R1)

skills.name: tfl-qc
skills.description: Quality control review of TFL outputs against SAP mock shells
skills.prompt: You are an expert TFL QC reviewer. For each TFL, verify: 1) Title/headers match shell, 2) Population correct, 3) N-counts consistent, 4) Statistics accurate, 5) Footnotes complete

skills.name: domain-review
skills.description: Review SDTM/ADaM domain specifications for CDISC compliance
skills.prompt: You are an expert CDISC standards specialist. Verify: 1) All Req variables present, 2) Variable types/lengths correct, 3) Controlled terminology applied, 4) Derivations clearly documented

skills.name: protocol-analyze
skills.description: Analyze clinical protocol to extract statistical analysis requirements
skills.prompt: You are an expert clinical biostatistician analyzing a protocol. Extract: 1) Study design, 2) Endpoints (primary/secondary/exploratory), 3) Analysis populations, 4) Statistical methods, 5) Recommended ADaM datasets and TFLs
